title: Replace fixed 50-item aggregate walls with Firestore cursor pagination (REQ-005 §8)
author: CheungHiuTung-2526 <250016155@stu.vtc.edu.hk>
commandsExecuted: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/firestore-family-documents.test.ts tests/firestore-shared-inputs.test.ts tests/firestore-restore-codec.test.ts tests/concern-capacity.test.ts tests/handover-concern-timeline.test.ts

cases: family documents scale past legacy 50 cap with cursor pagination and duplicate guards
shared inputs scale past legacy 50 wall with cursor pagination and boundary checks
concerns scale past legacy 200 aggregate wall with cursor pagination and timeline limit enforcement

timelineGuardCounterexample.description: Mutating prepareChange by setting full = false intentionally breaks the 200 event timeline limit guard
timelineGuardCounterexample.observedResult: tests/firestore-cursor-pagination.test.ts failed with AssertionError: Missing expected rejection on 201st append (RED)
timelineGuardCounterexample.restorationResult: Restored full = value.eventCount >= CONCERN_EVENT_LIMIT returns all suites to 3/3 PASS (GREEN)

legacyDuplicateCounterexample.description: Creating a growth report without envelope kind (simulating pre-R1 legacy record) and creating a second indexed report, then attempting duplicate of legacy report
legacyDuplicateCounterexample.observedResult: Old single-pass indexed scan missed legacy record duplicate; new bounded two-pass scan in activeCount() strictly catches and rejects duplicate with report_exists (GREEN)

endToEndPaginationVerification.description: HTTP API and Agent tools (list_private_sources and read_concerns) navigate beyond item 50 to items 51-55 and locate concern #150 without truncation or 404
endToEndPaginationVerification.observedResult: Default list discloses nextCursor when >50 items; client inputs() paginates across cursor pages; read_concerns directly fetches concern #150 by ID and continues searching across pages when page 1 has 0 matches (GREEN)

concernsClientSchemaCounterexample.description: Fetching concerns via ConcernsApi.getPage when store returns hasMore/nextCursor
concernsClientSchemaCounterexample.observedResult: Old strict pageSchema rejected unexpected hasMore/nextCursor with ConcernApiError (schema); updated pageSchema allows optional fields, passing empty and multi-page HTTP checks (GREEN)

agentConcernTraversalCounterexample.description: Agent read_concerns requested 50 from store but sliced to 20, jumping nextCursor past items 21-50 or returning null cursor on 40 items
agentConcernTraversalCounterexample.observedResult: Updated read_concerns aligns store limit with 20 items, ensuring 40, 21, and 55 items traverse without skip or duplicate (GREEN)

retainedSafetyGuards: Growth report duplication check (report_exists) preserved with bounded two-pass scan checking indexed where('status', '==', 'active').where('kind', '==', 'growth_report') and active legacy records
Single concern event timeline limit (CONCERN_EVENT_LIMIT = 200) strictly enforced at 201st append with concern_history_requires_review (400)
Archive action confirmed and permitted at CONCERN_EVENT_LIMIT to allow lifecycle closure
Cross-child and malformed cursor rejection strictly enforced (invalid_input 400)
Deterministic keyset pagination ordering preserved with tie-breaking
eliminatedAggregateWalls: Eliminated 50 active family documents creation limit (document_limit)
Eliminated 50 shared inputs creation capacity limit (inputs_capacity)
Eliminated 200 total child concerns creation and listing limit (concern_history_requires_review)

Live Gemini Live model API integration
Mobile app native UI / React Native device execution
limitations: Executed against in-memory Firestore synthetic fixture and Node.js test runner
Production Firestore load testing and emulator stress testing not run

Production front-end growth screen controller (frontend/src/production/task-knowledge-growth.ts) executes single-page initial getPage and has not yet wired paginated continuation triggers; cursor pagination capability is enabled and verified across Firestore store, HTTP API, client SDK, and Agent tools, while UI continuation remains pending controller wiring

Growth report deduplication (activeCount) executes bounded batch reads (limit 100 with startAfter) across active rows within a single Firestore transaction; it guarantees bounded query batch size and prevents memory bloat, but is not an O(1) constant-time bound under massive data datasets
